title: Star Wars Rebels Funko Pop #168  Fifth Brother - Walmart Exclusive
descriptionText:
Box is in rough shape.

This Star Wars Rebels Funko Pop #168 features the Fifth Brother from the popular TV show Star Wars: Rebels. Made of vinyl material and designed in Vietnam, this figure is a must-have for any Star Wars fan. It comes in its original packaging (unopened) and includes a plastic protector to keep it safe. 

This Funko Pop is a Walmart Exclusive, making it a rare and sought-after item. Its rarity is Vaulted/Retired and it was released in 2018. The Fifth Brother is part of the Pop product line and is a modern era collectible (1970-Now). The California Prop 65 Warning is Safe and it is a great addition to any collection.
